verdict.rationale: Letta ships an official CLI (Letta Code) with rich documented features: interactive slash commands (/agents, /fork, /remember, /doctor), headless/non-interactive mode for CI/CD and UNIX pipelines, ephemeral one-shot runs, and login/cloud sync — confirmed by first-party docs and a dedicated CLI docs page. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the CLI itself (community evidence discusses the product generally but not CLI usage specifics), and no explicit CLI version/changelog or install instructions in the pack.
